title: Harborline SiteGuard Terms Schedule: Renewal, Grace, Plan Moves and Money-Back
content:
This schedule of Website Security terms sets, for each Harborline SiteGuard tier, the figures that govern auto-renewal, renewal after expiry, moves between tiers and the money-back guarantee.

## Renewal and grace

| Term | Essentials | Plus | Pro | Business | Ecommerce | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Auto-renew on by default | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Days before the term end on which the renewal is charged | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Calendar days after an unpaid term end during which the plan can be renewed | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |

## Money-back guarantee and refundability

| Term | Essentials | Plus | Pro | Business | Ecommerce | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after the opening date within which an immediate cancellation of a 12-month plan is refunded | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Shortest term covered by the money-back guarantee, months | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| A plan that has had an expert manual cleanup loses the money-back guarantee | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A 1-month term charge is ever refunded | No | No | No | No | No | No |

## Moves between tiers

| Tier | Tiers the plan may move up to mid-term |
|---|---|
| Harborline SiteGuard Essentials | Harborline SiteGuard Plus, Harborline SiteGuard Pro, Harborline SiteGuard Business, Harborline SiteGuard Ecommerce, Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise |
| Harborline SiteGuard Plus | Harborline SiteGuard Pro, Harborline SiteGuard Business, Harborline SiteGuard Ecommerce, Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise |
| Harborline SiteGuard Pro | Harborline SiteGuard Business, Harborline SiteGuard Ecommerce, Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise |
| Harborline SiteGuard Business | Harborline SiteGuard Ecommerce, Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise |
| Harborline SiteGuard Ecommerce | Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise |
| Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise | None |

On every tier an upgrade is billed on the basis of the remaining days of the term, and a move down takes effect only at renewal.

Columns of the first two tables are the tiers Harborline SiteGuard Essentials, Plus, Pro, Business, Ecommerce and Enterprise.

## Notes on the schedule

- The money-back period is counted in calendar days from the opening date; the grace period is counted in calendar days from the unpaid term end.
- Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise lists no tier to move up to.
- *Can a Harborline SiteGuard Pro plan move up to Harborline SiteGuard Plus mid-term?* No. Plus is not among the tiers Pro may move up to mid-term, and a move down takes effect only at renewal.
